case_convergence.explanation: The three inputs are distinct, as their input hashes show. B changes only allowed_as_v551_relation_evidence, C changes only structural_mapping_status, and the supplemental control changes only semantic_role_authority_status. Each fails the same quc_is_certified gate, and the historical function normalises all three into the same fail-closed cleared-coordinate output. The equal output hashes are therefore an observed property of the historical branch, not duplicated case execution.

execution.first_reader_caveat: The test-time invocation path and first reader prove only how this author-side synthetic experiment called and read the historical function. They are not proof of the original historical production first reader, its call site, its inputs, or its authority.
execution.test_time_first_reader: run_f03_s2_native.py::execute_case and the assertion checks in AssertionLog are the first code that reads the returned output

hostile_interpretation.conclusion: The preservation branch conditionally preserves six already-present inbound coordinates and the inbound CERTIFIED/RELATION_EVIDENCE labels. It explicitly reports question_relation_registry_match=false and question_relation_authority_resolution_status=BLOCKED_MISSING_AUTHORITY. It does not establish who certified the source, whether that issuer was competent, or whether original source/scientific permissions exist.
hostile_interpretation.limitation: The supplemental control removes inbound certification and shows F03 fails closed; this is consistent with F03 consuming, not creating, semantic authority. It does not by itself prove the provenance of the inbound flags in the original historical production run.
hostile_interpretation.rejected_conclusion: Because F03 preserved six coordinates and marked the inbound row certified, F03 itself established original source authority.
